title: Stack encoding of a sentinel code
statement: For every Boolean string $xs$, the compiled stack-machine encoding of the singleton list containing its sentinel numeric code is the stack word of $xs$: its bits as bit symbols, followed by the sentinel true-bit symbol and the list terminator.
replaced:
Mathlib's stack encoding of the singleton list containing the sentinel numeric code
of a Boolean string $xs$ equals the stack word of $xs$: the bits of $xs$ as bit
symbols, then the sentinel true-bit symbol, then the list terminator.
